title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the Real Estate Management Authority Can Revoke an Erroneous Cancellation of Mortgage Registration

articles.content_en:
Interpretation No. 17 [2003] of the Supreme People's Court
To the Higher People's Court of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region:
Your Court's Request for Instructions regarding the appeal case of Capital Electromechanical Equipment Trading (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd. v. Liuzhou City Real Estate Bureau concerning the cancellation of mortgage registration, revocation of the (1997) Liufang Ta Zheng Zi No. 0410 House Right Certificate, and the request for return of the 0410 House Right Certificate has been received. Upon review, the reply is as follows:
A real estate administration authority may revoke an erroneous act of cancellation of mortgage registration.
October 17, 2003
